purpose: On-disk TOML schema and file->env->CLI merge for textbrush configuration. Extended additively with per-model selection and default-editing-preset fields so pre-epic config files keep loading unchanged.

public_api.name: Config
public_api.signature: @dataclass Config(output: OutputConfig, model: ModelConfig, huggingface: HuggingFaceConfig, inference: InferenceConfig, logging: LoggingConfig, editing: EditingConfig)
public_api.description: Complete textbrush configuration; adds new `editing` section.

public_api.name: EditingConfig
public_api.description: New leaf dataclass holding the selected model identifier and the default editing preset key. Both fields are additive with safe defaults matching current FLUX.1 schnell text-to-image behavior.

public_api.name: create_default_config_file
public_api.description: Extended to write the new [editing] TOML section.

public_api.name: load_config_file
public_api.description: Extended to read the optional [editing] section, falling back to defaults field-by-field when absent (backward compatible with pre-epic files).

public_api.name: apply_env_overrides
public_api.description: Extended with TEXTBRUSH_EDITING_MODEL_ID and TEXTBRUSH_EDITING_DEFAULT_PRESET, following the existing TEXTBRUSH_SECTION_KEY convention.

public_api.name: load_config
public_api.description: Unchanged signature and merge order (file -> env); now also merges the editing section.

external_ports: textbrush.paths (CONFIG_PATH constant, existing dependency, imported lazily inside load_config as before)
